english: How an alert reaches a family

Many people on the chars share basic phones and many do not read. Voice alerts worked better than SMS in a Practical Action pilot with about 10,000 people, and the government already runs a free voice forecast line, 1090. বন্যা সাথী adds what radar saw near each home, and a way to answer.
